summary: The return type of the public JSONTypeConverter.to_typed_value method includes a private type _JSONTypeConverterUnhandled that cannot be imported, preventing proper type-hinting of overridden methods in custom converters.
userImpact: Users who subclass JSONTypeConverter cannot properly type-hint their overridden methods without importing private implementation details.
rootCause: The _JSONTypeConverterUnhandled type is not exported in the public API despite being part of the return type of a public method.
keyQuote: I don't have a good way to type hint the return type of my method unless I import an underscore prefixed name
